chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ja'far bin Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The enemy of action is laziness.
ai.seo_question: What is the enemy of action according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* through the chain of Sahl ibn Ziyad, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) succinctly defines laziness (*al-kasal*) as the fundamental enemy of *amal* (deeds), encompassing both ritual worship and worldly endeavors. In Shia ethical tradition, this is not merely a critique of idleness but a warning that spiritual stagnation arises from the failure to actualize potential through consistent effort. The teaching underscores the necessity of *mujahada* (self-struggle) as the antidote to the paralyzing effect of sloth.
